Idle Startup is made by a solo developer with the help of generative AI. The milestone background artwork — the illustrations that unlock as each skill levels up — is generated with AI image tools and then selected and curated by the developer. The game's code is also written with the assistance of AI coding tools. All music and sound effects are generated procedurally in code, the interface art and icons are hand-drawn, and all in-game text is written by the developer.

Core design elements including units, animations, visual effects and sound effects were all created by real artists. AI tools were used solely for supporting assets like background images, portraits, buttons, and background music. These AI-generated assets were subsequently modified by our team. This approach enabled our three-person team to concentrate on core design and game mechanics.

As a solo developer, I actively leverage modern development tools to deliver my project to players with the highest levels of performance and stability. In this context, throughout the game's development cycle, Generative AI tools have been utilized for:
- Steam Workshop & MapKit Support: The coding infrastructure for modding tools (MapKit) and integration systems that allow players to design their own maps and easily import them into the game.
- Music and Audio Optimization: Implementing algorithms that ensure dynamic audio management and music streaming function without causing performance degradation.
- Network Architecture and Efficiency: Managing data and optimizing systems to minimize abnormal network usage (network spikes/overhead).

1. Generative AI acts as your virtual Game Master: Classic lateral thinking puzzles rely on a human host's flexible judgment. We use AI to fulfill this role, instantly interpreting your open-ended questions in real-time to provide accurate "Yes," "No," or "Irrelevant" responses. This replaces rigid scripts with human-like judgment, allowing you to enjoy the full deduction experience solo.
2. AI empowers the Creation Mode: The AI can transform your simple prompts, scenarios, or endings into complete puzzle sets, allowing you to instantly generate fresh mysteries to play or share with others.
3. Visual assets are pre-generated by AI: To support the game's detective atmosphere, visual assets were generated with AI assistance, then carefully curated and integrated into the game.

Our game utilizes AI in various aspects.
Code: AI algorithms are applied to optimize the game's code, ensuring smoother gameplay and better performance. This includes improving character pathfinding and adjusting in-game parameters for an ideal difficulty level.
Text: We use AI-driven natural language processing to assist in text-related tasks, like ensuring consistency and grammar in the in-game text for items, locations, and descriptions.
Textures: AI, such as generative adversarial networks, helps in creating high-quality textures for different surfaces in the game, enhancing the visual appeal.
Sound Effects: AI is used to analyze and manipulate sound effects, making them more realistic and in tune with in-game actions and events.
Music: AI algorithms analyze musical styles to compose original music that sets the right mood for different game scenes.

In this game, we incorporate artificial intelligence technology to transform port art assets into dynamic video materials, achieving cinematic dynamic effects. All AI-generated content has undergone secondary processing and in-depth optimization by our design team, seamlessly integrating into the game's overall art style. AI was used in the creation of certain visual assets, including character avatars, title screen artwork, promotional materials, and background art. However, these assets still required substantial manual work such as design, sketching, outline drawing, and polishing. The AI was used primarily as a tool for coloring and enhancement, and it did not dictate the creative direction. The visual style remains faithful to the original Little Fighter 2.
Some people assume that because AI was used in certain artwork, it must have been applied throughout the entire project. That is far from the truth. I used AI primarily for large-scale visual tasks. To give a clearer picture: the game includes over 3,000 hand-crafted sprite frames, composed from thousands of hand-drawn body parts. In contrast, only about 100 images were AI-assisted, and many of those, such as promotional artwork, don't even appear in the actual game.
I understand that some people may have concerns about the use of AI in the creative process. But I hope people can see the broader context and appreciate the amount of manual effort that went into making this game. Please know that I’m a solo developer working with a limited budget. I’ve been developing this project for around 3.5 years; even quitting my full-time job for a year to work on it full time, without expecting it to cover even half of my previous salary. I've done my best to balance quality and practicality. Your understanding and support mean a great deal to me.

We're just a small team who loves making games and we love using AI to make them even better.
We know there’s been a lot of negativity around AI in games lately, and honestly, we get it. But for us, AI isn’t some big scary thing, it’s a tool we use every day with excitement and care. It helps us bring our world to life, and gives players new ways to express their own creativity.
In our game, AI is used to make things feel more alive. It helps players voice their characters, translate their stories for others to enjoy around the world, and build cool things they might not have been able to otherwise. We're not using AI to replace artists or writers, we're using it to give more people the power to create.
We believe in giving players tools, not walls. AI is one of those tools, and we're constantly working to use it in thoughtful, respectful ways that fit our vision and our values.
So if you're on the fence about AI in games, we just ask: give it a chance. We’re doing our best to make something special here. This game is built with love, and we hope that shows in every part of it, even the parts powered by AI.

Capsule images have been generated with AI.

This is a one-man project, featuring imagery generated with the help of AI and then manually refined.

Music is AI generated.

Generative AI may be used in some cases in order to speed up development. In all such cases, output is reviewed carefully by a human and modified to fit the game's style. 99% of the game is made by a human, with no AI assistance.
